Flow.description: Runs AI enrichment analysis on a Contact, comparing CRM data to external sources (live web search{{#if linkedIn.enabled}}, LinkedIn{{/if}}{{#if zoomInfo.simulationField}}, ZoomInfo{{/if}}) and creating suggestion records for any discrepancies found.
Flow.label: Generate Contact Enrichment Suggestions

fields.name: ConfirmMessage
fields.fieldText:
AI-Powered Contact Enrichment


This will analyze the contact's data against external evidence - a live web search{{#if linkedIn.enabled}}, the LinkedIn "no longer at company" signal{{/if}}{{#if zoomInfo.simulationField}}, and (when available) ZoomInfo{{/if}} - to identify potential discrepancies:

  • Title and role changes
  • Department or company changes
  • Contact information updates (email, phone)
  • Employment status changes (retirement, departures)


Any existing pending suggestions will be replaced. Previously accepted or dismissed suggestions are preserved.


Click Run Enrichment Check to begin. The live web search can take up to 60-90 seconds, so please wait for it to finish.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.fieldText:
An error occurred while running the enrichment analysis. Please try again.


Error: {!$Flow.FaultMessage}

fields.name: SuccessMessage
fields.fieldText:

{!var_OverallAssessment}
